meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品链接或脚本自动转为宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作产品发布或推广视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create product launch or promotional videos

howto.what: 将产品链接、脚本或简介转化为宣传视频。它会抓取品牌素材、设计分镜、生成配音和动画帧，最终输出 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 当你提供产品/营销链接、粘贴脚本或简要描述，并希望制作宣传视频时触发。也适用于网站导览。

say.text: 根据这段脚本生成一个产品发布视频：……
say.note: 技能会使用脚本作为旁白并规划画面。

say.text: 给我的网站做个展示视频：https://example.com
say.note: 技能会抓取网站截图并制作导览视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a product link, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video. It captures brand assets, designs storyboards, generates narration and animated frames, and outputs an MP4 video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief and want a promotional video. Also for site tours/showcases.

say_en.text: Make a promo video for this product: https://example.com/product
say_en.note: Skill will scrape the link and start production.

say_en.text: Generate a product launch video from this script: ...
say_en.note: Skill uses the script as narration and plans visuals.

say_en.text: Create a showcase video for my website: https://example.com
say_en.note: Skill captures screenshots and makes a tour video.
